DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの服の着心地について、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any preferences about how the clothes you are looking for feel to wear?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真では柔らかそうでした。でも、首に触れる所が気になるので、見た目だけで決めず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真印象だけで買わず首の接触感を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: They looked soft in the photo. But I am concerned about the parts that touch my neck, so I would like to check rather than decide just by appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check how the garment feels against your neck rather than buy based only on the photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分が気になるか、お見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me which parts concern you?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 襟の縫い目と内側の札です。生地全体が硬いと感じているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 問題箇所は襟縫目と札で全生地硬さではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: The collar seam and the label on the inside. I do not mean that the fabric as a whole feels stiff.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the problem areas are the collar seam and label, rather than the stiffness of all the fabric. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 触り方や試着の取扱いを確認してからお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the rules for touching and trying on the item before you try it.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。札を切ればよいと決めて、買う前に切ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試用条件を聞き購入前の札切断はしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I will not decide that cutting off the label would solve it and cut it before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for trying the item and state that you will not cut off the label before buying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 素材の表示も確認できますが、ご自身の感じ方とは分けてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also check the material label, but please distinguish that information from how it feels to you when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。同じ素材名の服なら全て平気とは考えず、この服で首に触れる位置を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同素材なら常に平気とせず当該服の接触位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I do not assume that every garment with the same material name will be comfortable for me. I want to see where this garment touches my neck.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume that the same material will always feel fine; check where this particular garment touches you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの形の服も比較されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to compare other styles as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 比較したいです。札をなくす作業を頼む前に、触れる位置が違う候補を見て選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札除去依頼より先に異なる形の候補を比較したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would. Before asking to have the label removed, I will look at and choose from options that touch different places.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to compare differently shaped options before requesting label removal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の部分が違う候補をご案内します。それでは、ごゆっくり比較なさってください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you options that differ in the parts you mentioned. Please take your time comparing them. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご滞在中に必要なお手伝いはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there any assistance you need during your stay?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の朝に起きる方法を相談したいです。電話の音だけでは気づきにくいので、別の方法があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話音で起きにくく別の起床補助が可能か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to discuss how to wake up tomorrow morning. I find it hard to notice just the sound of a phone, so I would like to ask whether there is another method.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is hard to wake to a phone sound and ask whether another form of waking assistance is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望の時刻と、普段お使いの方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your preferred time and the method you normally use.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六時半です。普段は振動する時計を使いますが、今回は持って来ませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六時半希望で普段の振動時計は持参していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Six thirty. I normally use a vibrating alarm clock, but I did not bring it this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want six thirty and have not brought the vibrating alarm clock you normally use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当館で用意できる物や対応について確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check what equipment and assistance we can provide here.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。部屋へ来てもらえると決めて友達へ話す前に、実際に頼める内容を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 訪室可能と他人へ約束する前に対応範囲を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Before assuming someone can come to my room and telling my friend that, I would like to know what I can actually request.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to know the scope of assistance before promising someone else that a room visit is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後にご案内します。携帯で設定できる方法もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will let you know after checking. Is there also a method you can set up on your mobile phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 振動の設定はできます。充電が切れないよう用意しますが、それだけで必ず起きると保証してほしいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯振動と充電は準備できるが確実起床の保証は求めないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can set it to vibrate. I will make sure it does not run out of battery, but I am not asking you to guarantee that this alone will definitely wake me.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you can prepare phone vibration and charging but are not asking for a guarantee of waking up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お手伝いの範囲と、ご自身で準備することを分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us distinguish the assistance we can offer from the preparations you will make yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。六時半の希望を伝え、可能な方法を聞いてから準備します。未確認の訪室を予約済みとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望時刻を伝え未確認訪室を予約済としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will state my preference for six thirty and prepare after hearing which methods are possible. I will not consider an unconfirmed room visit already booked.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your preferred time and say that you will not regard an unconfirmed room visit as already booked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対応できる内容を確認いたします。それでは、ご案内まで少々お待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check what assistance we can provide. Please wait a moment until we can advise you. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの絵を使った物について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss making something using the picture you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖父の絵を提灯の図柄にできるか聞きたいです。絵を持って来ましたが、祖父に渡す原作そのものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祖父の絵の原作で提灯図柄の可否を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to ask whether my grandfather's painting can be used as a paper lantern design. I brought the painting, but it is the original itself, which I am going to give to my grandfather.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to ask whether your grandfather's original painting can be used as a lantern design. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原作を加工してよいかどうかも、先にお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please first check whether it is all right to alter the original itself as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 加工は頼みません。形や色を見てもらう資料として出し、写しで相談できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原作加工を依頼せず写しで相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not requesting any alteration to it. I would like to present it as reference for the shapes and colors and ask whether we can discuss the design using a copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can discuss the design using a copy without requesting alterations to the original. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 完成品に残したい特徴は、どこでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which features would you like to retain in the finished item?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この細い青い線です。ただ、写真では青が黒く見えるので、写真だけを正しい色見本にしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 細い青線を残したく写真の黒い見え方を正色見本としないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: This fine blue line. But the blue looks black in the photo, so I do not want to use the photo alone as an accurate color sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to retain the fine blue line and will not treat its black appearance in the photo as an accurate color sample. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 制作方法や色の扱いは、担当と確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the production method and handling of colors with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。祖父が描いた部分と、私が加えたい文字も分けて説明します。全部を祖父の作品と呼びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 祖父の絵と自分の追加文字の作者を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will also explain separately which parts my grandfather painted and which lettering I want to add. I will not call all of it my grandfather's work.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the authorship of your grandfather's painting separately from the lettering you want to add. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 制作を頼む前に、確認内容を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us organize what needs to be checked before you request production.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原作は持ち帰ります。今日は可否の相談だけにして、祖父の希望と文字の配置を確かめてから改めて来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原作は持帰り今日は相談だけで本人希望確認後に戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the original home. Today I will just ask whether it is possible, then come back after checking my grandfather's wishes and the placement of the lettering.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the original home, only seek advice today, and return after checking your grandfather's wishes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料として拝見するご希望を伺いました。それでは、原作を大切にお持ち帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand that you want us to look at it as reference material. Please take good care of the original on your way home. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 少しお休みになる場所をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest for a while?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 音が重なって、買い物を続けにくくなりました。友達はまだ店を見たいので、私だけ一度休みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音で買物継続が難しく同行友人と別に休みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: The overlapping sounds have made it hard for me to keep shopping. My friend still wants to look around the shops, so I would like to take a break on my own for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the sounds make it hard to continue shopping and that you want to rest separately from your accompanying friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通行の妨げにならない場所をご案内します。ご友人にはお伝えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will show you somewhere that does not obstruct people passing through. Have you told your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。黙って別の道へ行かず、休みたいことと今いる店の名前を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 黙って離れず休憩希望と店名を送ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Instead of silently going off down another route, I will send a message saying I want a break and giving the name of the shop I am in now.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will not leave silently and will message your wish for a break and the shop's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの場所も、お二人で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also agree on a meeting place between the two of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友達に買い物を全部やめてもらうのでなく、私は必要な一店だけにする予定を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の買物全中止を求めず自身は一店に短縮すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than asking my friend to stop shopping altogether, I will explain my plan to limit my own shopping to just one necessary shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will shorten your own shopping to one shop without asking your friend to stop all shopping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動先の音の状況も、その時にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the sound conditions at the new location when you get there.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。静かと決めつけず、案内された場所を見てから休めるか判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内先も静かと保証せず現地を見て休めるか決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will not assume it is quiet; I will see the place you suggest before deciding whether I can rest there.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not assume the suggested location is guaranteed quiet and will decide whether you can rest after seeing it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物と連絡手段をお持ちのまま、ご移動ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take your belongings and your means of communication with you when you move.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯と袋を持ちます。落ち着いたら連絡し、元の店へ必ずすぐ戻るという約束はしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯と袋を持ち落着き後連絡し即帰還を約束しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take my phone and bag. I will get in touch once I feel settled, and I will avoid promising to return to the original shop straightaway without fail.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take your phone and bag, contact your friend after settling down, and not promise an immediate return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない範囲でお過ごしください。それでは、ご友人との連絡を確かめてご移動ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stay within what feels manageable for you. Check your communication with your friend before moving. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 年表の読み方について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about how to read the timeline?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つの出来事が横に並んでいます。同じ年だと子どもへ話しましたが、数字を見ると違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 横並びを同年と説明したが数値は異なると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two events are shown side by side. I told my child they happened in the same year, but the numbers are different when I look at them.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you described side-by-side events as being in the same year but have found that their numbers differ. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配置と年代を分けて確認しましょう。どちらの数字をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the layout separately from the dates. Which numbers did you look at?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見出しの大きい数字だけです。出来事の下の小さい日付は読んでいませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見出しのみで各出来事の小日付を未読と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the large numbers in the heading. I had not read the small dates below each event.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you only read the heading and had not read each event's small date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 各項目の期間や日付を、説明と合わせて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look at the period or date for each entry together with its explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一年の出来事と長い期間の紹介が混ざっているかもしれないので、横並びだけで同時とは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単年と期間の可能性を考え配置だけで同時としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Events from a single year may be mixed with descriptions covering a long period, so I will not say they were simultaneous just because they are side by side.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider that single years and longer periods may be mixed, and say that layout alone does not mean simultaneity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない表示は、解説担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the guide about any labels you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもには私の最初の説明を直してから、順番を一緒に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子へ旧説明を訂正して順序を一緒に読みたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I would like to correct my initial explanation to my child and then look at the order together.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to correct your earlier explanation to your child and read the sequence together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 年表の線や区切りについても、ご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also ask about the lines and divisions on the timeline.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に区切りの意味を聞きます。古い方が必ず左だと決めず、表示の読み方に沿って比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区切りを先に聞き左が古いと決めず表示方法で比較すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first ask what the divisions mean. I will not assume that the older item is always on the left; I will compare them according to how the display is meant to be read.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will first ask about the divisions and compare according to the display's conventions rather than assume older means left. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 読み方の確認先をご案内します。それでは、お子様とご見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to someone who can explain how to read it. Enjoy your visit with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出発の日時をご確認になりたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check the departure date and time, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅の予定に土曜日の零時半とあります。土曜の夜に来るつもりでしたが、友達は金曜の夜と言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 土曜零時半を土曜夜と考え友人の金曜夜案内と違うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: My itinerary says half past midnight on Saturday. I intended to come on Saturday night, but my friend says Friday night.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you took Saturday at half past midnight to mean Saturday night, which differs from your friend's guidance to come Friday night. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 土曜日の午前零時半は、金曜日の夜を過ぎた後です。予約の年、月、日も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Half past midnight on Saturday is after Friday night. Let us check the year, month, and day of your reservation as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。出発の日付を見ずに「土曜の夜」と伝えました。まず予定の年、月、日も読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 曖昧な夜表現をやめ年と月と日を読むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: You are right. I said "Saturday night" without looking at the departure date. I will first read the year, month, and day on the itinerary too.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will stop using an ambiguous expression about the night and read the year, month, and day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗る予定の便や、出発場所も資料でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check your planned service and departure location in the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。時刻だけこの駅の列車だと決めず、予約の案内と照合します。まだ切符を買い直すつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻だけで当駅列車とせず便と場所を予約で照合すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not assume it is a train from this station based on the time alone; I will compare it with the reservation information. I am not planning to buy replacement tickets yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the reservation to check the service and departure location instead of assuming it is a train from this station based only on the time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待ち合わせ相手へは、日付と時刻を両方伝えると明確です。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is clearer to give the person you are meeting both the date and the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金曜日の夜から土曜日に変わった後の零時半ですね。友達へ、予約にある日付と時刻をそのまま送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金曜夜の後の土曜零時半と理解し予約日時を友人へ送ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: So it is half past midnight after Friday night has turned into Saturday. I will send my friend the date and time exactly as shown on the reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand it is Saturday at half past midnight after Friday night, and say that you will send your friend the reservation date and time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移動の方法は、出発場所の案内も見てご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consider how to travel after also looking at the directions for the departure location.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確かめてから家を出る時刻を決めます。「明日の夜」だけで話さず、同じ日付を二人で見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家の出発時刻を確認後決め相対日付だけで待合せないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will decide when to leave home after checking. Rather than just saying "tomorrow night," we will both look at the same date.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide when to leave home after checking and will not arrange the meeting using only a relative date expression. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご予定の記載をご確認ください。それでは、日時をそろえてご準備ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check what is written in your itinerary. Prepare with your dates and times aligned. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の前に、味についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about the flavor before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの頃に父と食べた味を探しています。「昔の味」と言えば同じになると思いましたが、具体的に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昔の味という曖昧さを具体化して注文したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for the taste of something I ate with my father as a child. I thought saying "the old-fashioned taste" would make it the same, but I would like to describe it more specifically.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to make your vague description of an old familiar taste more specific when ordering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 覚えている特徴と、今日のご希望を分けてお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me separately the characteristics you remember and what you would like today.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 香りはよく覚えていません。塩味が強すぎず、麺が柔らかかったことは覚えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 香り不明で弱い塩味と柔らかい麺は記憶にあると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not remember the aroma well. I do remember that it was not too salty and that the noodles were soft.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not remember the aroma but do remember a mild salty taste and soft noodles. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当店の品の説明はできます。思い出と同じ味になるお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can explain the dishes we serve. I cannot promise the same taste as in your memories.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それで大丈夫です。父の記憶を再現してもらうのでなく、今の私の好みに合う品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父との味再現保証を求めず現在好みで選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is fine. Rather than asking you to recreate my memories with my father, I will choose something that suits my current preferences.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will choose according to your current preferences without asking for a guarantee of recreating the taste you shared with your father. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更のご希望は、できる範囲を確認して承ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can accept requests for changes after checking what is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 柔らかめにできるか聞きたいです。薄味にすれば自動で麺も柔らかくなるとは考えず、別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 麺柔らかめ可否を味の変更と別に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to ask whether the noodles can be made softer. I will discuss that separately, without assuming that making the flavor milder automatically makes the noodles softer too.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether softer noodles are possible, separately from changes to the flavor. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 麺のご希望と、味の説明を順に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check your noodle preferences and the explanation of the flavor in turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。説明を聞いてから一杯を選びます。知らない香りを覚えていたことにして注文へ加えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後一杯を選び不明香りを記憶として足さないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will choose a bowl after hearing the explanation. I will not add an aroma I do not remember to the order by pretending I remembered it.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose a bowl after the explanation and will not add an unknown aroma as if it were a memory. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認してご案内します。それでは、少々お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check your preferences and advise you. Please wait a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 連絡用の端末で、お困りのことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the communication terminal?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手袋だと画面が反応しません。今の作業中に手袋を外して押すより、先に操作方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手袋で画面未反応なので外す前に方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen does not respond when I wear gloves. Rather than taking off my gloves to press it during the current work, I want to ask how to operate it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the screen does not respond to gloves and ask about the method before removing them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作業と端末操作をいったん区切り、指示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us pause and separate the work from operating the terminal, then check the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。今は指定された待機場所です。機械を操作しながら画面も押している状態ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定待機場所で機械との同時操作ではないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I am now in the designated waiting area. I am not operating machinery while also pressing the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are in the designated waiting area and are not operating machinery at the same time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 端末を使う場所や方法を確認します。何を送りたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check where and how the terminal should be used. What do you want to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資材が届いた連絡です。急ぐ気持ちはありますが、送るために保護具を自己判断で変えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資材到着連絡を急いでも保護具は自己変更しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: A message that the materials have arrived. I do feel a sense of urgency, but I will not change my protective equipment on my own just to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that even though you are eager to report the materials' arrival, you will not change protective equipment on your own. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 反応がないからと、画面を何度も押さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not press the screen repeatedly because it does not respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。何度も送信されたかも不明なので、別の方法で連絡できるかと送信状態を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連続押下をやめ送信状態と代替連絡を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I also do not know whether it has sent multiple times, so I would like to check the sending status and whether I can communicate another way.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Stop pressing repeatedly and say that you want to check the sending status and an alternative way to communicate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が操作と連絡の方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to operate it and how to communicate.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その案内を待ちます。端末を使えないことと作業を再開してよいことは別として、今の待機を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 端末不調を作業再開の許可とせず待機を続けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for that guidance. I will continue waiting here, treating the inability to use the terminal as separate from permission to resume work.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that a terminal malfunction does not mean permission to resume work and that you will keep waiting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を確認しました。それでは、案内まで端末操作を止めてお待ちください。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand the situation. Stop operating the terminal and wait for guidance. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貯金計画のメモで確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check in your savings-plan notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 六万円貯まったので、目標の半分と書きました。でも、最初の目標は十万円で、途中から十二万円も考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六万円を半分と書いたが目標十万と十二万が混在と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have saved 60,000 yen, so I wrote that I am halfway to my goal. But my original goal was 100,000 yen, and partway through I also began considering 120,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote 60,000 yen as half the goal but have mixed goals of 100,000 and 120,000 yen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの目標を使った割合か、分けて整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us separate and organize the percentages according to which goal they use.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十万円なら六割ですね。十二万円なら半分です。残高が変わらなくても、目標を変えると割合が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十万なら六割十二万なら半分と目標別計算を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: For 100,000 yen, it is sixty percent. For 120,000 yen, it is half. Even if the balance stays the same, changing the goal changes the proportion.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the calculations for each goal: sixty percent of 100,000 yen and half of 120,000 yen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 目標は、いつまでに用意するご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: By when would you like to have the target amount ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 旅行のためですが、出発はまだ決まっていません。十二万円にする理由も、費用を聞いてから考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旅行日未定で費用確認後十二万円目標の理由を検討したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is for a trip, but the departure is not decided yet. I would also like to think about the reason for choosing 120,000 yen after finding out the costs.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the travel date is undecided and that you want to consider the reason for a 120,000-yen goal after checking costs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談の前に、確定した金額と未決定の計画を分けていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before the consultation, you can separate the confirmed amounts from plans that are still undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今の六万円と、二つの目標を別に書きます。達成率が高く見える方だけを選ぶことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在残高と二目標を分け達成率の見栄えだけで選ばないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will write the current 60,000 yen separately from the two goals. I will not choose just the one that makes my progress look higher.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate the current balance and the two goals and will not choose solely for an impressive-looking completion percentage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新たな入金の方法も、担当へご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also discuss ways to add further deposits with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は計画の確認だけです。積立の契約を始める前に、目標額と時期を自分で整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回は相談のみで契約前に目標額と時期を整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today is only to check my plan. Before starting a regular savings contract, I will organize the target amount and timing myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that this visit is only for advice and that you will organize the target amount and timing before entering a contract. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 計画のご相談として担当へつなぎます。それでは、メモをご用意ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge for a planning consultation. Please have your notes ready. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご案内の列車で、目的の駅へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you heading to your destination station on the train we indicated?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、到着して荷物を受け取る約束があります。次の列車で着く時刻を確認して、相手に知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物受取の相手へ知らせる到着時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I have arranged to collect some luggage when I arrive. I want to check when I would arrive on the next train and let the other person know.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the arrival time so you can inform the person from whom you will collect luggage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先と、お約束の時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your destination and the time you arranged to meet.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅です。三時に会う予定ですが、今から乗れる列車だと何時ごろになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行先と三時の約束を示し次列車時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This station. We plan to meet at three, but about what time would I arrive on a train I can take from now?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your destination and the three o'clock arrangement, and ask about the next train's arrival time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの時刻表では三時二十分の到着です。運行の案内もあわせてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This timetable shows an arrival at three twenty. Please also check the service information.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二十分遅れる予定と連絡します。相手が待てないなら、荷物の受け取りは別の日にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遅れを知らせ待てなければ別日受取と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell them I expect to be twenty minutes late. If they cannot wait, I would like to collect the luggage another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will report the delay and collect the luggage another day if they cannot wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗る前に、ご連絡を済ませられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you finish contacting them before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今メッセージを送りました。三時半まで待てるそうなので、この列車で行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手が三時半まで待つ返信を得て乗車を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I just sent a message. They say they can wait until three thirty, so I will take this train.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to board after receiving a reply that the other person can wait until three thirty. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 改札を出てから待ち合わせ場所までは、お時間を取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please allow time to get from outside the ticket gates to the meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。相手には駅前へ出てから電話すると伝えました。列車がさらに遅れたら、途中でも連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅前から電話し追加遅延時も連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I told them I would call after coming out in front of the station. If the train is delayed further, I will contact them along the way as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will call from in front of the station and also get in touch if there is any additional delay. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、表示を確かめて乗り場へお進みください。荷物を無事に受け取れますように。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the signs and proceed to the platform. I hope you can collect your luggage without any problems. Take care.
